name: Creates a new data class
description: Creates a new data class Creates a data class for use in DLP profiles. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes
Creates a data class for use in DLP profiles.
Required: account_id (path); body (body) — Attributes of the new data class.

name: Delete a single data class
description: Delete a single data class Deletes a data class from the account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes/{data_class_id}

name: Retrieve all data classes in an account
description: Retrieve all data classes in an account Lists data classes configured for the account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes
Lists data classes configured for the account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Retrieve a specific data class
description: Retrieve a specific data class Gets the configuration for a data class. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes/{data_class_id}

name: Update the attributes of a single data class
description: Update the attributes of a single data class Updates the configuration for a data class. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/dlp/data_classes/{data_class_id}
